name: Request Behind Classroom Doors
source:
Yui Ameno is a first-year high school student in an all-girls school who is socially awkward and struggles to make friends. She isn't close with anyone in her class, except for the popular model student Fumiko Kihara, whom she admires. One day, Fumiko confesses her feelings to Yui, and they start dating, but on one condition: Yui has to play along with Fumiko’s masochistic fantasies. 

[From [url=https://moshiitokuuu.itch.io/request-behind-classroom-doors]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Yui Ameno是一所女子学校的高中一年级学生，她不善社交，很难交到朋友。除了她崇拜的受欢迎的模特木原富美子之外，她与班上的任何人都不亲近。有一天，Fumiko向Yui坦白了自己的感情，他们开始约会，但有一个条件：Yui必须配合Fumiko的受虐幻想。

[来自[url=https://moshiitokuuu.itch.io/request-behind-classroom-doors]itch.io[/url]]
